_note: MMCTOY1 M1 (S569): Mixed Martial Cards' distance structure on our boxer. Two places - Outside (range 3) and the pocket (range 2, Mid and Inside as one) - plus the clinch from the pocket. The jab and the body jab are LONG RANGE: a miss or a block of one gives no counter; a punch timed for his step in from Outside is a step-in counter (+N.counter). A back off from the pocket CREATES DISTANCE: Outside, the beat ends there, the other man has the lead. THE LEAD = his punch lands first when both throw at the same speed in the same moment. The feint is a MODE of a punch (fnt: 'lead', the lead hand's punches; 1 stamina, no damage): he covered that line = off rhythm next beat (no counter bonus, his hands in moment 1 are where he held them last beat); he did not = he takes the lead. The Feint and Push off cards are gone: a jab in the plan stops his clinch. Every anchor is ONE line (order.html is CRLF in this checkout, LF in git). docs/MMCTOY1_RESULT.md.
